name: Lost Clan Relic (Ancestral Amulet Detail)
description: Ancestral 3D showcase of a vanished samurai clan's heirloom amulet. A heavy dark bronze and obsidian war medallion set with glowing blood-red rubies, featuring crossed gilded katana blades and an imperial solar crest, resting inside a dark lacquer reliquary chest.
prompt: Masterwork 3D detailed concept art of an ancient lost samurai clan relic medallion. An ornate circular war amulet of dark blackened bronze and obsidian, set with glowing blood-red rubies and featuring crossed golden clan katana blades with an imperial sun crest centerpiece, resting on dark silk. Pure pitch-black background (#000000), radiant crimson red (#FF2035) aura and rim lighting, 8k render, no text.
